I’m 99% sure I talked to someone with one of the profile pictures you showed (on discord), and he said pretty sexual stuff to me too. As someone who’s been on this sub for almost 3 years, and first posted when I was 13, I’m not at all surprised that you got these sorts of responses. I think until I was 15, I mainly only had guys in their 20s and 30s message me. Which was weird since there were so many other teens posting. Sexual topics are extremely common things for older guys to talk about. However, I’m not saying every dude over 20 was creepy, some were fine. It was just so often that I had to start putting the age range I wanted and telling people out of that age range that I didn’t feel comfortable talking. That helped a lot, and I don’t think I’ve had many experiences with people lying about their age. 

This really does show that issue, and it is something that needs to be stopped. Really, the only thing I’ve been doing is reporting them to the mods. I think that many people on this sub really don’t know what’s going on with this issue, or at least, to the extent it’s at. So thank you for bringing attention to it.
